q: How long did the sugar take to dissolve in trial 1 at 20 degrees C?
Calculate the mean time at 20 degrees C.
Identify the anomaly in the table and calculate the mean at 40 degrees C without it.
52 s at 40 degrees C is the anomaly. Mean = (35 + 33) / 2 = 34 s.
Describe the pattern and suggest why the anomaly might have happened.

As the temperature increases, the time to dissolve decreases (60 s, 34 s, 19 s). The anomaly may be from not stirring the same way, a larger sugar cube, or the water cooling down before the cube was added.
